_comment: The reference viewer's presets, declared rather than written in Python. Each entry is a title, the one line that is both its menu tooltip and its `preset_cx` listing, and the commands it runs -- so a preset can be added or retuned without touching code, and the documentation cannot drift from the thing it documents because there is one copy of it. `{sel}` is the selection the preset was applied to. Read by chimol.cmd.presets (the command) and chimol.app.menu_bar (the menu). Transcribed from the reference viewer's documented behaviour, never from its source.

presets.title: Ribbons
presets.description: Cartoon with flat arrows on strands and rounded loops -- the default reading view.
commands: spectrum count, rainbow, {sel} and name ca

presets.title: Cylinders
presets.description: Helices as plain tubes: says a helix is here and nothing about its face, which is what shows packing.

presets.title: Licorice
presets.description: One constant round section throughout, no arrows -- for a model whose secondary structure is not the point.
commands: spectrum count, rainbow, {sel} and name ca

presets.title: Ghostly white surface
presets.description: A white surface you can see the model through -- shape outside, fold inside, in one picture.
commands: spectrum count, rainbow, {sel} and name ca

presets.title: Surface, atom colours
presets.description: A transparent surface taking its colour from the atoms beneath it.

presets.title: Surface, by chain
presets.description: An opaque surface, one colour per chain -- the shape of an assembly and who contributes what.

presets.title: Publication: silhouettes
presets.description: White background and outlines. The flat, printable look; global, not per selection.

presets.title: Publication: depth-cued
presets.description: White background with depth instead of outlines -- for an assembly whose every strand would otherwise be outlined.

presets.title: Interactive
presets.description: Back to the working view after a figure preset: dark background, depth cue, no outlines.

presets.title: AlphaFold confidence
presets.description: Colour a prediction by pLDDT -- low warm, high cool. Reading a prediction without its confidence is the mistake that database invites.
